aps.t: ancient plane simulator (flight test) - a cockpit sim
posts:
hello forum,

i present **ancient plane simulator**, a first-person cockpit flight simulator running entirely in your browser... well, on your machine.

what it has:
- a full clickable cockpit: yoke, levers, overhead panel, radar
- auto take-off (T) and autoland (K)
- real flight model: fuel, hydraulics, gear, flaps
- two destinations: JRNA and MASTER KING
- an honest crash screen

this is a TEST BUILD. please read the agreement on the download page. ancient air systems is not liable for damages caused by flying to MASTER KING.

gl.t: how do you make a good game loop?
posts:
hello,

as a beginner, i am struggling with the main loop of my game. should logic and drawing run at the same speed?

thank you,
gamedev gabe
run logic at a fixed step and draw as often as the machine allows. do not tie movement to the frame rate.
basic is fine for this. just use a timer.
how many switches is too many for a cockpit game? my overhead panel has 22 and every one does something.
